raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?c
  where all
    match
      relation "be a class at"
      role object "Fitzone Parramatta"
      role subject ?c
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be scheduled in"
      role subject ?c
      role time "this week"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have available spaces"
      role subject ?c
      role object ?spaces
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?c
      role object "spin"
      polarity negated
    end
  end
  compare ?spaces above 3
